5625.title: Local path links bypass preview routing
5625.rootCauseOneLine: Trusted-host bare paths require a dotted basename, trailing separators are rejected, and thread resolution has no directory outcome.
5625.proposedFix: Add directory-aware path resolution while preserving app-route and containment policies; verify file and directory clicks through the real renderer and desktop.
5625.caveats: DOM routing and missed local-open callbacks reproduced twice. The final macOS Electron/system-browser navigation was not exercised. Complete reproduction test is inline in the report.
